name: LoveSpark Habit Garden
summary: Grow a garden by building habits. Track streaks, watch plants bloom. Built for ADHD brains.
description:
LoveSpark Habit Garden turns your daily habits into a growing garden. Add habits, check them off each day, and watch your plants bloom as your streaks build.

Designed for ADHD and neurodivergent brains — visual feedback, satisfying progress, zero overwhelm.

Features:
- Add and track daily habits with one click
- Visual garden grid that grows with your streaks
- Daily reset with streak tracking
- 4 cozy themes (Retro Pink, Dark, Beige, Slate)
- Full keyboard and screen reader support
- No account required — everything stays in your browser

Privacy first: No data collection, no tracking, no ads. 100% local storage. Always free, always open source.

Part of the LoveSpark suite — retro pink productivity tools for neurodivergent coders.
